purpose: Bounded, repeatable presentation review; not gameplay or performance certification.

rules: Do not move the authored camera for a beauty angle.
For Arena framing review, capture the same stable state at the authored default and both bounded yaw endpoints.
For Ember Vault framing review, capture the same stable Boss state at yaw 0, yaw 325, and yaw 65.
Do not orbit outside the per-mode bound, pan, zoom, or change camera pitch or distance between comparison captures.
Do not hide HUD elements that are visible in normal gameplay.
Capture stable combat states, not arbitrary particle peaks.
Treat the current environment as prototype evidence, not final-quality art.
Keep logs and captures outside Assets.

setup: Use the normal PvE Leveling camera, isolated capture saves and camp indices 0 through 6; capture all seven districts with one specialization per district.
Camp 0 Frost at 1920x1080; camp 1 Discipline, camp 2 ShadowDance, camp 3 Fire, camp 5 Mutilate and camp 6 Shadow at 2400x1080; camp 4 Marksmanship at 2592x1080.
Also capture camp 4 at the bounded yaw endpoints 35 and 145 degrees.
Capture camp 0 at the north and south playable shoulders with lateral offsets +7 and -7, using yaw 35 and 145 respectively.
requiredEvidence: characters and floor surfaces remain readable in shadow without additional shadow-casting lights
near-field camp details, broken paving, distinct district landmarks and bounded vegetation are visible
the playable corridor remains visually and physically unobstructed
existing class silhouettes, XP, nameplates and target markers remain readable
rejectIf: most of the scene is featureless black
new dressing hides the player or implies impassable objects inside Core walkable bounds
floor decoration resembles hostile telegraphs
brightening the world changes Arena, Siege or Boss lighting after leaving the region

setup: Start Arena.
Select an ally by roster, then an enemy in the world.
Leave one enemy unselected and all four combatants alive, then capture the same stable state at yaw 90, yaw 30, and yaw 150.
requiredEvidence: compact roster HP and class badges
human, focus, immediate threat, wardstones, and relevant arena edge remain readable at the authored default and both bounded endpoints
rejectIf: team or focus depends on color alone
roster or target UI hides central combat
selected world hero differs from selected roster unit
an orbit endpoint lets prototype perimeter art hide combatants, cover, feet, or the stone-to-lava boundary

setup: Show Deep Freeze before Frozen exists.
Trigger the global cooldown while another ability has its own cooldown.
Begin a Frostbolt cast with a valid enemy focus.
requiredEvidence: GCD radial distinct from ability cooldown
rejectIf: blocked, GCD, cooldown, and casting look equivalent
icon identity disappears under overlays
player cannot name the next actionable blocker

setup: Cast Fireball across open ground.
Use Dragon's Breath at close range.
Use Blast Wave near the safe-stone edge.
rejectIf: all three abilities read as flying balls
effect hides target health or feet
knockback direction is unclear

setup: Apply Frost Nova to a nearby enemy.
After GCD, resolve Deep Freeze on that enemy.
Show Ice Barrier on the player.
requiredEvidence: Deep Freeze resolution distinct from setup
rejectIf: Nova and Deep Freeze share the same silhouette
Frozen setup is unreadable without button text
barrier obscures team/focus markers

setup: Enter stealth or a Shadow Dance access window.
Approach from behind and use an opener.
Capture the opponent roster while the Rogue is stealthed.
requiredEvidence: obscured but present stealth roster token
rejectIf: character presents the spine as forward
opener is represented only by a magic projectile
stealth leaks world position or live status

setup: Apply poison with Shiv or Mutilate.
Build target-bound combo points.
Resolve Envenom.
requiredEvidence: poison setup distinct from physical hit
rejectIf: builder and finisher use indistinguishable timing/shape
combo points cannot be associated with the focused target
green color is the only venom identifier

setup: Select an enemy across a wardstone.
Show LOS rejection while preserving focus.
Start a legal cast, move the target behind cover, and capture miss resolution.
rejectIf: visible cover and authoritative LOS disagree
LOS failure silently substitutes another target
miss looks like successful damage/healing

setup: Fight near the safe-stone edge.
Use or receive Blast Wave toward lava.
Capture lava contact, recovery attempt, and one death/recap.
rejectIf: lava reads as walkable decoration
death appears instantaneous or arbitrary
spell effects obscure feet or the edge

setup: Start the legacy Boss encounter so Ember Vault is the active Boss presentation.
Keep the party and Rift Warden alive in one stable readable state.
Capture that same state at Boss yaw 0, yaw 325, and yaw 65.
requiredEvidence: scaled first-party carved floor language shared with Rift Crucible
thin readable boss and recovery inlays without filled primitive platforms
first-party fortress shoulders and exactly two distinct ember landmarks
party, boss, inlays, landmarks, and relevant floor edge remain readable at the authored default and both bounded endpoints
no visible KayKit Dungeon environment floor, wall, pillar, stair, or rubble language
rejectIf: the old filled boss dais or recovery platform returns
KayKit Dungeon environment modules are visible in Ember Vault
fewer than two ember landmarks remain distinguishable
a Boss-orbit endpoint hides the party, boss, inlays, landmarks, or relevant floor edge
the shared first-party kit is described as final environment art

setup: Start Training on Ashen Causeway and capture Ashbound Raider plus Cinder Marksman in West Refuge.
Capture Causeway Prelate plus Rimebound Frostweaver in Cinder Approach.
Capture Ashbound Brute plus Reliquary Warder at Broken Gate.
Capture the Collapsed Court breathing space after the central pack.
Capture Ashbound Raider, Cinder Marksman, and Cinder Hexer in Ossuary Bend, then the empty Reliquary Yard staging space.
Capture the Rift Warden finale at East Watch.
requiredEvidence: distinct refuge, approach, gate, court, ossuary, reliquary, and watch landmarks
current district, pack, and eastward objective
all eight hostile archetype identities remain distinguishable through names, badges, scale, and primary/signature spell language at gameplay scale
the Rift Warden chains Cleave, Rift Roar, and a warning centered on the actual resolved Meteor point
rejectIf: the route reads as copied arena circles
walls read as a repeated panel fence
foreground architecture hides feet, targets, or attacks
enemy proxies are presented as production creature art

setup: At level 1, capture exactly three learned actions with no reserved circles or future-skill previews.
After pack one, capture the named reveal and the fourth learned action in its stable authored position.
After pack four, capture the final named reveal and all seven learned actions.
requiredEvidence: three-action start with no locked, empty, or preview control
one-at-a-time learned-action reveals in stable authored positions
level-up feedback and named skill unlocks distinct from damage
seven learned actions at level 5 with no swipe-direction cues
pack recovery and district-aware ADVANCE EAST guidance
rejectIf: progression is visible only in transient particles
XP or level overlaps the objective or target UI
a cosmetic effect appears to grant the level
the player can idle at spawn and activate every pack
a locked circle, empty placeholder, or future-skill preview is visible
an unlearned action can be cast or a learned action fails to appear
